_about: Sir Thomas Malory's (d. 1471) Le Morte d'Arthur in two public-domain texts, each its own work: Caxton's 1485 text in modern spelling, in two volumes (clean Gutenberg; Caxton's book and chapter division), and Sir Edward Strachey's Globe edition (1868, rev. 1891, clean Gutenberg), which modernises and expurgates. Malory wrote in English, so no translator is owed; the editor is in each title. Retellings for children (Knowles, Lanier's Boy's King Arthur, Cutler, Macgregor, Holland, Charles Morris) are left out.

malory-morte-darthur-caxton-1: Le Morte d'Arthur, Caxton's text (1485) in modern spelling, vol. 1
malory-morte-darthur-caxton-2: Le Morte d'Arthur, Caxton's text (1485) in modern spelling, vol. 2
malory-morte-darthur-strachey: Le Morte Darthur, ed. Sir Edward Strachey (Globe edition, 1868, rev. 1891)
